description: Changing the dock edge in Left, Right, Top, Bottom order switches the surface orientation and icon Flow for each edge.

assertions.comment: Left edge: the panel sits against the left side of the screen with only the 8px Floating margin
At the left edge, the panel is vertical, so its width shrinks to one icon row
Right edge: coordinates use the dock window, whose width is 108px, so an 8px right margin puts the panel at x=36
Top edge: the panel lies at the top of the screen with an 8px margin
At the top edge, the panel is horizontal again, so its height returns to one row
Returning to the bottom edge (the default) returns the panel to its bottom position
